rationale: Record a root-View debug-overlay change that crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through its core/view paint selectors. The TRACING reminder badge the root View paints when Perfetto tracing is compiled in now centres its label on measured ink (measure_text_full ascent/descent) instead of a fixed 72%-of-height baseline, exposes that geometry as the pure tracing_badge_layout() function, and lets an app move the pill with set_tracing_badge_placement() whose defaults reproduce the historical corner placement. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, render backend, asset, codegen output, fixture or threshold changes; the badge is a developer-only overlay absent from non-tracing builds. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
